featured_reviews.name: ADESH TOLUMBIA
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing experience. I bought both a leather chappal and a bag from this store, and both tore apart within a very short time. At the time of purchase, they confidently assured me that the products came with a warranty. But when I went back to address the issue, instead of honoring it properly, they simply said, “we can just stick it for you.”

Completely unacceptable for products sold as quality leather goods. The staff at both the Bombay store and Delhi store were extremely dismissive and unhelpful once the sale was done. Please avoid these scammers. Horrible customer service and poor product quality.

featured_reviews.name: TUSHAR SHINDE
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently made the huge mistake of buying a pair of shoes from Padtran in Mira Road for ₹3,000. At the time, I thought it was a decent purchase, but just three days later, I found the exact same shoes on the original brand's official website for only ₹1,800!
I honestly couldn't believe the massive price difference, so I actually ordered the shoes directly from the brand's website just to compare them. Let me tell you, they are 20000% identical. It is the exact same material, the exact same quality, and the exact same shoe. Padtran practically charged me double the actual price for absolutely no reason!
They are looting customers with insane markups. It is incredibly disappointing to see a local store scamming people like this. I strongly request everyone reading this: NEVER buy anything from Padtran. Save your hard-earned money, do a quick online search, and just buy directly from the brands. This place is absurdly expensive and a total scam!

Overall, a disappointing experience—not recommended.
